regressionChecks.reloadViews: Passed initial binding, released-player cleanup, reused controls, repeated preference changes and native control availability. The previous bundle fails the reused-controls case.
regressionChecks.replayAndSettingsWindow: Passed replay touch routing, repeated system-bar/cutout preference changes, rotation and lifecycle.
regressionChecks.patcherMigration: Morphe Patcher 2.0.1 lazy resource decoding: 23 of 6482 files decoded on 31.8.0_BETA.
regressionChecks.extensionControls: Required component contracts resolve on 31.7.0, 31.8.0 and 31.9.0_BETA. Earlier native and React Native hide/show acceptance retained.
regressionChecks.reducedSelection: Show deleted messages alone passed full DEX rebuilding and SDK verification on 31.7.0; zero introduced findings.
regressionChecks.fullscreenRequests: Android runtime probes passed 20 repeated modern and legacy host requests, live preference changes, restoration and keyboard preservation.
regressionChecks.channelActions: Native metadata models preserve Follow and notification callbacks while filtering Subscribe and gifting. Native chat-overlay Subscribe uses the existing visibility policy.
regressionChecks.backgroundPlayback: Native lifecycle and React Native policy tests pass. DJ screen-off playback failed on the previous candidate; the bundle-source correction awaits device acceptance.
regressionChecks.reactNativeBundleSource: Host bundle-source contract resolves uniquely on all three declared targets. Full APK rebuilding and original-aware SDK checks pass; no new hierarchy findings. Device acceptance pending.
regressionChecks.streamAdWarmup: Four tests pass for immediate startup, late clean results, rendition isolation and cancellation. The existing 2.2-second foreground budget is unchanged.
regressionChecks.creatorSponsorships: Native banner/header contracts and React Native query/placement contracts resolve on all three declared targets. Generated capture instructions and inherited Android method references are tested; three adapter tests cover live toggles and cached creatives. Device acceptance pending.
regressionChecks.releaseAuditDeviceTesting: No phone interaction or installation during this audit.

knownLimitations.streamAds: If no clean compatible alternative is available within the bounded search, original media is retained and an ad can appear. Live preroll/midroll acceptance remains pending for this build.
knownLimitations.storyAds: No verified ad-specific request or presentation contract. Stories ad coverage is not claimed.
knownLimitations.clientAdRequests: Native request suppression; changing this setting requires a restart.
knownLimitations.deletedMessages: Native and React Native chat are covered. Text must remain in the received message; earlier deleted history cannot be recovered. A live React Native moderation event remains an acceptance check.
knownLimitations.googlePlayBilling: Unavailable in the evaluated re-signed app.
knownLimitations.notifications: Registration is included; actual delivery timing requires a live notification event.
knownLimitations.experimentalVersion: 31.9.0_BETA is experimental and requires normal-use acceptance.
knownLimitations.reload: Current React Native Classic Split requests reached the player. A separate intermittent layout failure has not been reproduced; native reused-control rebinding is covered by regression tests.
knownLimitations.hypeTrains: Native event-state and React Native selector tests passed. Live Hype Train transitions still require an event on an available channel.
knownLimitations.emoteDrafts: Input previews are confirmed in native chat. The user reports missing draft images in React Native Vertical View; chat rendering and autocomplete remain available.
knownLimitations.djBackgroundPlayback: Screen-off playback on 31.9.0_BETA remains unconfirmed after repeated failed device candidates. The packaged-bundle correction requires user acceptance.
knownLimitations.creatorSponsorships: Native and React Native suppression is covered by hook and adapter checks. Live sponsorship transitions still require device acceptance.

emoteInputDevelopment.deviceAcceptance: User confirmed autocomplete and inline emotes working on mobile. Native suggestions were also inspected with images and names.

emoteInputDevelopment.composerContracts: Matched React Native composer and input contracts on 31.5.2, 31.6.0, 31.7.0 and 31.8.0_BETA.
emoteInputDevelopment.remainingChecks: Full legacy-input rebuild checks for retained targets are recorded under targets. Versions 31.5.2 and 31.6.0 are no longer supported.

androidManagerBuild.deviceInstall: Passed an in-place update with the existing Manager signing key; app identity and data retained.

deviceChecks.fullscreenLifecycle: Passed three off/on cycles, settings-window resizing, rotation and 45 steady-state samples.
deviceChecks.settingsControls: Passed three off/on cycles through the actual System bars controls, followed by 30 seconds of stable fullscreen playback without a restart.
